name: DataKeeper
title: Data Keeper
about: Every place an app keeps data: @AppStorage settings, Codable and JSON, files in the sandbox, SwiftData models with relationships and migrations, secrets in the Keychain, and iCloud sync.
notes: iCloud and CloudKit run in a clearly labeled simulated mode, because they need the paid Apple Developer Program. The real code is included for you to read.
The appearance picker in lesson 6.2 is saved, so the app stays in the mode you pick until you change it back.
To see the save that happens when the app leaves the screen (lesson 6.1), press Command-Shift-H in the Simulator, then return.
